competences: The learner locate days and activities in a weekly plan.
The learner answer questions in full future-tense sentences.
languageCompetence: Pronounces, reads, spells and uses correctly: work plan, kennel, novel, uniform, rabbits.
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to locate days and activities in a weekly plan.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to answer questions in full future-tense sentences.
priorKnowledge: Learners have read Akot’s future plan and know the days of the week.
references: P 4 ENG & SST Lesson Notes Term III 2023

steps.content: Learners have read Akot’s future plan and know the days of the week. Key words: work plan, kennel, novel, uniform, rabbits
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher displays namata weekly work-plan chart and links the chart to the prior knowledge: Learners have read Akot’s future plan and know the days of the week. The teacher pronounces the lesson vocabulary, checks learners’ reading, and introduces reading: namata’s work plan.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall familiar words, read the displayed key words aloud, and explain what they already know about the topic.

source.quote: Study Namata’s work plan for next week

steps.stage: Development: Namata’s work plan: Sunday to Wednesday
steps.content: Namata’s work plan: Sunday to Wednesday: Sunday: She will go to church. Sunday: She will feed the rabbits at 10:00 a.m. Monday: She will clean the kennel. Tuesday: She will read a novel. Wednesday: She will go for P.E. at school.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: Sunday: She will go to church. Sunday: She will feed the rabbits at 10:00 a.m. Monday: She will clean the kennel. Tuesday: She will read a novel. Wednesday: She will go for P.E. at school. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "On which day will the rabbits be fed?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: Study Namata’s work plan for next week

steps.stage: Development: Namata’s work plan: Thursday to Saturday
steps.content: Namata’s work plan: Thursday to Saturday: Thursday: She will visit aunt Suzan after school. Thursday: She will wash her P.E. uniform. Friday: She will start on her mixed exercise. Saturday: She will go to the beach with her parents.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: Thursday: She will visit aunt Suzan after school. Thursday: She will wash her P.E. uniform. Friday: She will start on her mixed exercise. Saturday: She will go to the beach with her parents. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "What will Namata do on Monday?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

source.quote: She will visit aunt Suzan after school

steps.content: Example: a full-sentence answer: Who will feed the rabbits? Namata will feed the rabbits.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher models reading of this content: Who will feed the rabbits? Namata will feed the rabbits. The teacher checks pronunciation and meaning, draws attention to the target wording, and asks: "At what time will Namata feed the rabbits?" Learners’ responses are checked against the displayed text.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the source sentences or entries aloud, identify the target words, answer the teacher’s question, and copy the stated content accurately.

steps.content: On which day will the rabbits be fed? What will Namata do on Monday? At what time will Namata feed the rabbits? What is the name of Namata’s aunt? With whom will Namata go to the beach?
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher gives the following sourced text-based exercise: On which day will the rabbits be fed? What will Namata do on Monday? At what time will Namata feed the rabbits? What is the name of Namata’s aunt? With whom will Namata go to the beach? The teacher checks learners’ written answers for meaning, spelling and punctuation, using this key: The rabbits will be fed on Sunday. Namata will clean the kennel on Monday. Namata will feed the rabbits at 10:00 a.m. Namata’s aunt is called Suzan. Namata will go to the beach with her parents.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer individually in their books, use full sentences when required, read selected answers aloud, and correct spelling or punctuation after feedback.

source.quote: On which day will the rabbits be fed

steps.content: Key answers: The rabbits will be fed on Sunday. Namata will clean the kennel on Monday. Namata will feed the rabbits at 10:00 a.m. Namata’s aunt is called Suzan. Namata will go to the beach with her parents.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher revisits these questions: On which day will the rabbits be fed? What will Namata do on Monday? At what time will Namata feed the rabbits? The teacher checks whether learners have met the objectives, explains any remaining errors using the source text, and assigns the final exercise item for correction.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners explain their answers with evidence from the text, read corrected sentences aloud, and note the final item for homework.

source.quote: With whom will Namata go to the beach

assessment: Check oral reading and written responses to these questions: On which day will the rabbits be fed? What will Namata do on Monday? At what time will Namata feed the rabbits? Mark meaning, spelling, sentence structure and punctuation against the displayed source models.
homework: Complete or correct the following source exercise item, writing the answer neatly: With whom will Namata go to the beach?
